_about: What one unit costs Knos to deliver, as `knos bill margin <month.json> docs/unit_costs.json` reads it. docs/UNIT_COSTS.md says where each figure comes from. A cost marked "budget" is a target nobody has measured; nothing has been sold, so no cost here was ever incurred for a customer.

pair_month.what: one anchored batch for one buyer-supplier pair in a month: 3 transactions (15,000 lamports) and the month's Ledger account (1,137,920 lamports of rent, not returned)

control_year_target.what: a year of onboarding and support for one Business customer once onboarding is self-service: a target nobody has reached

payee_account.what: rent of a payee's first token account, 1,488,440 lamports; whoever relays puts it up
